task: Review the supplied photo candidates within each provided group. Judge observable quality separately from which photos should be retained for human review.
grouping_contract: Groups are supplied by configurable adjacent capture-time continuity AND perceptual-hash proximity. Hash threshold zero disables hash checking. Do not replace this grouping rule with semantic or action-based grouping.
instructions: Use only visible image evidence and the neutral image IDs. No system scores, model names, quality labels, filenames, or previous reviewer answers are supplied.

Select at least one keep in every group with readable photos, even when all are low quality. Explain coverage selection separately from observable quality defects. Do not increase a quality score because a photo must be kept.
Return no selected best or reject label for an unreadable-only group; report the decoding/input error.
Assess visible subject focus, exposure, composition, subject moment and obvious defects. Do not infer tiny RAW focus differences from insufficient previews.
Missing eye or face evidence is unknown. Back-view or silhouette not_applicable requires explicit visible supporting context; report the evidence and uncertainty.
Allow ties, multiple acceptable keeps and abstention on uncertain pairwise preferences. Preserve distinct visible moments when useful, while retaining the supplied group boundaries.

Return JSON only. For each group provide group_id, readable_ids, acceptable_keep_ids, preferred_ids, quality_findings_by_id, selection_reasons_by_id, pairwise_preferences, uncertainty and errors. Pairwise entries must contain first_id, second_id and preference of first, second, tie or unknown. Cite IDs only from the request.

evaluation.order_check: Independent second request for each group with reversed image order and fresh neutral IDs; do not expose the first answer.
evaluation.baseline: Frozen current full scoring and group-selection policy. Client-only mean dimension scores are not a substitute for the production selection policy.
evaluation.limitations: GPT judgments are model_generated proxy references, not human ground truth or personal preferences. Synthetic controls and action-classification data cannot establish real burst-selection accuracy. Do not tune on held-out events.
